## What's Changed - Bump to 0.0.20 - Drop notarization blurb from release notes - Add podcast search via iTunes Search API - Fix crash when duplicate PlaybackRecords share an episodeKey
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geoffoliver/podstash/compare/v0.0.19...v0.0.20

macOS build below is a universal binary (Apple Silicon & Intel), Developer ID signed and notarized — no Gatekeeper warnings. Unzip and drag Podstash.app to /Applications.
## What's Changed - Bump to 0.0.18 - Shrink CloudKit sync to queue/progress/subscriptions; fix perf regressions this exposed
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geoffoliver/podstash/compare/v0.0.17...v0.0.18

macOS build below is a universal binary (Apple Silicon & Intel), Developer ID signed and notarized — no Gatekeeper warnings. Unzip and drag Podstash.app to /Applications.
## What's Changed - Bump to 0.0.16 - Fix all Xcode build warnings - Fix duplicate episodes and orphaned downloaded files - removed commented code - updated "queue" sidebar icon - updated icon
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/geoffoliver/podstash/compare/v0.0.15...v0.0.16
